4RoHOKUgYNEB6K0TmLiK.definitionOfDone: Perform test, provide feedback and measure to Alberto
4RoHOKUgYNEB6K0TmLiK.description:
Ventilated Cabinet motor works full speed unresponsive to input. Company technician provide feedback remotely and ask additional test to isolate the problem and help find the solution.
The idea is only to verify two things:
1.	Power supply of the transmitter, Measure between +24V and GND, Expected value: approximately 24 V DC
2.	Output signal of the transmitter, Measure between SIGNAL OUT and GND
We are not looking for a precise calibrated value. What we need to know is simply:
•	if the signal is present and changing slightly while the cabinet is running (normal behavior), or
•	if the signal remains completely fixed or close to 0 V, which would strongly indicate that the pressure transmitter is faulty.
Link -> https://istitutoitalianotecnologia-my.sharepoint.com/:i:/r/personal/alberto_galbusera_iit_it/Documents/Documenti/Ventilated-Cabinet_test.png?csf=1&web=1&e=AsMT1w
4RoHOKUgYNEB6K0TmLiK.title: Malfunctioning Mouse Ventilated Cabinet - MRI Lab - Multimeter test
